description: Unofficial fan art of Cirno from Touhou Project, drawn as a childlike ice fairy with blue hair and bow, a blue-and-white dress, opaque white tights and six angular crystalline wing branches. Nine animations feature a palm-sized ice crystal, proud gestures, crystal reshaping, a wing-glint turn, alternating runs and a short jointed leap. Tights and choreography are original modest adaptations; no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
